heading: Sash Window Restoration
subheading: Protect and restore your home's original features.
lead: Sash windows are a fabulous feature of any period home but like any other feature, they can begin to look tired, become draughty and difficult to maintain
bodyHtml:
The Complete Restoration Company recondition sash windows on-site, replace sash cords, add draught excluders and repair any damage.

We offer the complete overhaul service for your sash windows, so while we’ve got the window out we will strip them back, prime and repaint them – you won’t believe they’re the same windows!
